piece.idea: A Reiki master wrote a UK number two, and it's both AI and human
piece.thesis: Movin' To The Sun reached number two in the UK. One of its writers started with her lyrics and an AI music app; strangers found the song under short videos before the charts did.
piece.body: If you've opened TikTok or Instagram this year, you've heard Movin' To The Sun.
